classification: real gap; new opt-in ARM rule
intent: System data belongs in the resource envelope, not in or below a properties bag.
applicability: Models containing a JSON-encoded property named properties in an explicitly ARM-selected program. No provider/resource-marker prerequisite: upstream selects all such definitions, including custom envelopes.
predicate: Traverse the properties-bag type graph using native model properties, inherited properties, indexer values and union variants. Report JSON property names systemData or SystemData. Do not inspect serialized schema metadata, examples, extensions or source text. Inherited indexers resolve nearest base indexer; compiler-resolved discriminator alternatives are payload alternatives, not arbitrary inheritance descendants.
